title: Bacara
subtitle: Adaptive Reading Companion
description:
Bacara is an AI-powered assistive reading ecosystem designed to help children with **dyslexia** access and understand conventional learning materials more independently.

The concept combines **Computer Vision** and **OCR** to transform printed textbooks and worksheets into customizable digital reading experiences. Through adjustable typography, personalized text layouts, and **Text-to-Speech**, children can interact with written content in ways that accommodate their individual reading preferences.

Beyond accessibility, the platform introduces an **interactive AI companion** that supports children throughout their reading journey. Through contextual reading assistance, educational mini-games, and a gamified progression system, the companion grows alongside the child — turning everyday reading into a more engaging experience.

The ecosystem also explores optional **Smart Glasses** integration, enabling hands-free text capture, voice interaction, and audio-assisted reading.
